title: 787. Escape The Ghosts

examples.explanation: You need 1 step while the closest ghost needs at least 2.
The ghost sits on the way and arrives first.
A tie still counts as a capture.

hints: On an open grid the shortest route length is the Manhattan distance.
Compute your distance from the origin and each ghost's distance to the target.
You escape exactly when your distance is strictly smaller than every ghost distance.
